# Huruy Kidanemariam — Senior UX Designer & Builder

> Portfolio of Huruy Kidanemariam, a Senior UX Designer and Builder crafting accessible, human-centered products for enterprise and social impact, with 8+ years of experience and 12M+ users impacted.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured UX case studies, skills, and overview.
- [About](/about): Background, expertise, and a UX trivia game.
- [Resume](/resume): Work history, education, and downloadable resume.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch about UX design and product work.

## Case Studies

- [Asure Compliance Engine](/project/asure-compliance): Onsite redesign of an enterprise payroll compliance engine serving 9,000+ tax agencies.
- [OneAsure Portal](/project/oneasure-portal): Unifying enterprise HR (time, benefits, payroll) into a single portal.
- [EBT Finder](/project/ebtfinder): Review-first store locator for 12M+ SNAP/EBT users.
- [Beles](/project/beles): Culturally rooted dating and community app for the Tigrayan diaspora.
- [FentFinder](/project/fentfinder): Harm-reduction tool for locating fentanyl test resources.
